extDesc.message: Translates only the language you pick, on sites you pick, with Chrome's on-device translator. Hover to see the original.

optionsIntro.message: Uses Chrome's built-in translator to translate only the foreign-language text on a web page. Translation runs on this computer, so page content never leaves it. Hover over translated text to see the original.

allSitesHint.message: When on, the translate switch appears on every web page. Chrome asks for access the first time you turn it on.

autoTranslate.message: Translate automatically when a page opens

emptySites.message: No sites yet. On a page you want translated, click the extension icon in the toolbar and press “Turn on” to add it automatically. You can also type a site below.

modelsHint.message: Each language pair's model is downloaded once (shared across Chrome). It can take a few minutes, so download the languages you read often in advance.

shortcutHint.message: ⌘K on Mac, Ctrl+K on Windows. Works with Korean or Japanese keyboard layouts and with Caps Lock on.

highlightHint.message: Adds a light background and dotted underline to translated text so you can tell it apart.

modelFirstHint.message: You only need to do this once (shared across Chrome). Keep this window open while it downloads.

noPage.message: Not available on this page (Chrome internal pages, the Web Store, etc.).

grantBody.message: To add the translate switch automatically every time you open a page on {1}, the extension needs access to this site.

grantNote.message: It's already applied to the current tab. If you just close this window, it works for this visit only.

grantOk.message: Access allowed. The translate switch will now be added automatically on this site. Closing this window.

grantNo.message: Access was not allowed. Click again to retry.

grantedOn.message: Access allowed. Turned on the site and automatic translation.

noTranslator.message: This version of Chrome doesn't support the built-in translator (Chrome 138 or later required).

noDetector.message: This version of Chrome doesn't support automatic language detection.

sameLang.message: The source and target languages are the same.

saved.message: Saved. Open tabs update right away; reload the tab for a site you just turned on.

badHost.message: That isn't a valid site address.

needGrantToAdd.message: You need to allow access to add this site.

noPermNote.message: Without access, it won't be added automatically on your next visit —

addedApplied.message: Added and applied to this tab.

needHttps.message: Chrome's built-in translator isn't available on pages without a secure (HTTPS) connection.

noTranslatorApi.message: This version of Chrome doesn't support the built-in translator (Translator API). Chrome 138 or later is required.

needClickPair.message: To start translating {1}→{2}, click the switch on this page once.

noDetectorApi.message: This version of Chrome doesn't support automatic language detection (LanguageDetector API).

detectorUnavailable.message: The language detection model isn't available.

needClickDetect.message: To start language detection, click the switch on this page once.

slowDownload.message: Downloading model… (the first time takes a few minutes)

serviceUnavailable.message: Chrome's built-in translator isn't available right now. Close other translating tabs or reload this page; if it still fails, restart Chrome.

legacyRefresh.message: The extension was updated. Please reload this page.

pillTitle.message: Translation on/off{1} · Hover over translated text to see the original

saveFailed.message: Couldn’t save. Storage may be full — delete some sites and try again.

grantExpired.message: This request has expired. Open the extension popup on the site and try again.

diagConsole.message: Diagnostics were written to the console.

clickAgain.message: A temporary error interrupted the download. Please click once more.

grantAllSites.message: Allow all sites — don’t ask again

grantAllHint.message: “Allow all sites” makes it work on every site right away. You can turn it off for a site, or entirely in settings.

useEverywhere.message: Use on all sites (allow once, works everywhere)
